criteria.description: A fresh documented installation can configure and start the service, validate its environment, identify PAPER mode, initialize the real schema, expose truthful health/status, and enforce absence of live-trading routes.
Offline verification succeeds without credentials and unavailable credential-backed checks are reported rather than bypassed.

Downstream modules consume normalized timestamped market/account snapshots; freshness and connection health are observable; restart reconciliation restores broker truth; PAPER protections remain intact.
Offline normalization/recovery fixtures and the highest authorized Alpaca verification rung are executed and documented.
Persisted inputs replay to the same versioned decision context; numerical/freshness rules are tested; unavailable data is explicit; provenance reconstructs later AI inputs.
LLM1 consumes only bounded validated decision context, produces locally validated versioned structured analysis, persists provider provenance/usage, and has no order authority.
Retry/error behavior and unsupported structured-output behavior are covered by deterministic tests or authorized observed evidence.
Jev uses versioned bounded questions and primitive-correct semantics, locally validates/recomputes results, persists provenance, and fails closed on provider/schema/consistency errors.
Any endpoint ambiguity material to correctness is resolved by authoritative or authorized observed evidence rather than guessing.
LLM2 receives the bounded upstream evidence, emits a validated confirm/reject/constrain verdict, cannot enlarge risk or directly submit orders, and persists stage evidence.
Deterministic risk policy is the final authority for exposure and routes only to Alpaca PAPER execution with idempotent order identity and restart reconciliation.
PAPER-only guards, stale-state rejection, kill-switch behavior, ambiguous submission handling, and order lifecycle reconciliation are deterministically tested.
Unattended PAPER orchestration drives every opportunity through a bounded persisted lifecycle to executed/no_action/blocked without overlapping duplicate decisions.
Restart recovery, in-flight limits, cadence/rate bounds, failure blocking, and stage/cycle latency observability are verified.
The dashboard truthfully reflects a running PAPER session, disconnect/stale/inactive/restart conditions, and traces PAPER execution through every AI and deterministic stage.
Browser code has no provider credentials or direct broker/model clients and kill-switch changes are server-side authorized deterministic transitions.
Relevant offline automated checks and deterministic replay/failure qualification pass.
Secrets remain protected, PAPER-only guards pass, and no live-order route exists.
Every executed verification rung and every outstanding external/runtime blocker is explicitly recorded.
Operator/developer/runbook documentation matches the resulting implementation.
Calibration/ablation reports preserve historical evidence and state sample-size, horizon, base rate, outcome definition, uncertainty, latency, usage, cost, and limitations.
The project is not described as live-qualified unless the corresponding credential-backed verification rung actually ran successfully.
